exposure: Bilateral transversus abdominis plane (TAP) blocks with liposomal bupivacaine
cohort: 288 patients who underwent cesarean delivery (142 historical controls, 30 recent controls, 116 intervention group)
finding: The use of bilateral TAP blocks with liposomal bupivacaine in conjunction with neuraxial morphine significantly reduced postoperative opioid use and shortened the length of stay for patients following cesarean delivery.
